request.description: Creates a default collection of pages, snippets, and customization config for a portal if they do not already exist. This endpoint is optional, you can call it to populate a newly created developer portal with default content, but it is not required. Existing pages and snippets will not be modified or deleted. If used, it is typically called once per portal shortly after creation.

request.description: This api allows the user to move a page within the page tree using the parameters parent_page_id and index. If parent_page_id is not provided, the page will be placed at the top level of the page tree. index represents a zero-indexed page order relative to its siblings under the same parent. For example, if we want to put the page at top level in first position we would send parent_page_id: null and index: 0. This api also supports using a negative index to count backwards from the end of the page list, which means you can put the page in last position by using index: -1.

Title and Description properties may be provided in the frontmatter section of `content`. If you set values in both the `POST` request _and_ in the frontmatter, the values in frontmatter will take precedence.
